entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to start?
Jane Doe, order 884-215-B. It's just not working.
Thank you, Jane. I have your account pulled up. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or just a preference?
It's defective. It won't sync with my phone.
I'm sorry to hear that. So it's the syncing that's the main problem. Can you tell me more about what happens when you try?
No. Look, the thing is broken. I just want to send it back. Are you going to help me or not?
Of course. I just need to check the return eligibility. One moment, please.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I see here that your item was delivered 16 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within that window.

I've just approved the return for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the defective band in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Whatever. As long as it's done.
It is. You should see that email within the next 5 minutes. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
